maintenance.intro: To keep your pool's water crystal clear for months, there are a few things worth paying attention to. Our goal is for our pools to need as little upkeep as possible, so you can spend your free time simply enjoying the water.

daily.title: Daily care
daily.text: When you're not using the pool, always put the thermal cover back on and secure it with the clips. If you won't be using a filled pool for a longer stretch, lift the cover once a week anyway to let it ventilate properly. The cover cuts heating time and the energy needed to hold the water temperature, keeps leaves out, and helps prevent unsupervised children from using the pool. It's also a warranty requirement: UV exposure can damage an empty pool shell, and that kind of damage isn't covered.

hardness.title: Water hardness
hardness.text: Recommended: 8–12 °dH. Determined by the dissolved calcium and magnesium salts in the water — hard water carries too much of these, so limescale precipitates over time, which can damage the pool wall, piping, filter and technical units. Hungarian tap water is typically medium-hard (~15 °dH); this can't be reduced with chemicals, only prevented from precipitating — soft water is produced with a resin-tank water softener.

ph.title: pH level
ph.text: Recommended: 7.2–7.6 (on a 0–14 scale, 7 is neutral). Above 7.8 the water stings bathers' eyes, and high pH reduces how well the disinfectant works — pH tends to drift upward over time, so a pH-reducer is usually what's needed. Recommended: a phosphoric-acid-based pH reducer — 1 litre per 100 m³ of water lowers it by 0.1, best dosed where the water flows in.

disinfection.title: Disinfection
disinfection.text: Disinfectant neutralizes microorganisms in the water (bacteria, algae, fungi, viruses) that get in via rain, wind and bathers, and that can turn the water cloudy. Recommended: Aqua Excellent, a 100% bio, chlorine-free disinfectant — about 100 ml per m³ of water, with the level checkable via test strip.

foam.title: Foaming
foam.text: Foam on the surface usually comes from skin residue, cosmetics and lotions mixing with chemicals — it counts as foaming if a layer is still visible half a minute after the massage jets are switched off. Recommended: Aqua Excellent Habstop anti-foam, dosed until the foaming stops and left to mix thoroughly into the water.

filter.title: Cleaning the filter cartridge
filter.text: The filter cartridge removes debris from the water, so cleaning it weekly is essential — a heavily soiled cartridge can't pass enough water through, and the control unit may flag an error. Soak the cartridges monthly in Aqua Excellent Filter Cleaner for 24 hours, and replace them every 3 months. Always cut power to the pool before removing a cartridge, and never run the pool without one — keeping a spare on hand is recommended.

quarterly.title: Every 3–4 months: water change
quarterly.text: At this point the pool should be fully drained and refilled with fresh water, with the filter cartridges replaced. Always refill through the filter housing — otherwise the circulation system can pick up air, which can damage the pool's heating element.

yearly.title: Yearly
yearly.text: An annual inspection by our service team is recommended — an on-site check assesses the pool's condition, and any needed repairs can often be carried out on the spot.

winterizing.title: Winterizing
winterizing.intro: If you won't be using the pool over winter, prepare it for the season — or leave it to our service team.
steps: Pump out the water with a submersible pump
Vacuum any remaining water out of the jets with a wet vacuum
Disconnect the motors' and controller's releasable fittings, unscrew the frost plugs, and remove any water from the motor pump housings

springPrep.title: Spring start-up
springPrep.intro: When you're ready to use the pool again, work through the steps below — or ask our service team for help.
steps: Reconnect the motors' and controller's releasable fittings
Clean any debris that fell into the pool body over winter
Fill the pool with fresh water
Check it's running properly (drips, leaks, motors)
